features: 【Multifunctional】featuring a compact and flexible design; ideal for working with your laptop or tablets beside beds or sofas.Also use this table as a nightstand, a laptop computer table, study desk, reading, writing, drawing or anything else that you could possibly think of.

【Adjustable &Movable & Lockable】Height of top panel is adjustable from 27.5 inch to 35.4inch(70-90cm),perfect for both adults and kids to use under different environment. The bedside table can be moved to anywhere with the universal wheel .Lockable wheels, easy to keep it steady.

【Humanized Details Design】2 drawers and open shelf provide large storage space; Top panel swivels 360 degrees laterally and vertically,offering a more comfortble working experience;safety edge-stopper to prevent objects from sliding off when the panel is tilted; There is a Q-type clip on the back of the panel to keep your cables neat; Surface is easy to keep clean.

【Health & High Quality】The Plate: Solid wood particle pressing, E1 grade environmental wood without any industrial glue, and 0 formaldehyde release. Metal Frame: Utilizes heavy-duty and powder-coated metal materials, which ensures stability and durability.
【Dimensions】This Nightstand size: 23.6L * 15.7W * 27.5-35.4H inch; Table weights about 44lbs, max weight capacity for top of desk: 60 lbs.
